The figure size, colors, transparency, line widths, axis labels, x-axis ticks, grid style, and zero reference line will remain unchanged. script = '''import seaborn as sns import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import pandas as pd import numpy as np from matplotlib.patches import Patch df = pd.read_csv("table.csv") plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6)) sns.set_style("whitegrid") palette = {"Positive": "#4ECDC4", "Negative": "#FF6B6B"} g = plt.gca() for impact_type in ["Positive", "Negative"]: curve = df[df["Impact Type"] == impact_type].sort_values("Impact Value") g.fill_between( curve["Impact Value"].to_numpy(), curve["Density"].to_numpy(), color=palette[impact_type], alpha=0.6, linewidth=1.5 ) g.legend( handles=[Patch(facecolor=palette[k], edgecolor=palette[k], alpha=0.6, label=k) for k in ["Positive", "Negative"]], title="Impact Type", loc="upper right" ) plt.axvline(x=0, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=1) plt.title('Distribution of Debt Impact Values on Fiscal Stability (2018)', fontsize=14, pad=20) plt.xlabel('Impact on Fiscal Stability (%)', fontsize=12) plt.ylabel('Density', fontsize=12) plt.xlim(-15, 20) plt.xticks(np.arange(-15, 21, 5)) plt.ylim(0, 0.200) sns.despine() plt.tight_layout() plt.savefig('output.png') ''' Path("chart.py").write_text(script) exec(compile(script, "chart.py", "exec")) print("Title:", g.get_title()) print("Limits:", g.get_xlim(), g.get_ylim()) print("Legend:", [t.get_text() for t in g.get_legend().get_texts()]) for collection, impact_type in zip(g.collections, ["Positive", "Negative"]): curve = df[df["Impact Type"] == impact_type].sort_values("Impact Value") vertices = collection.get_paths()[0].vertices assert all(any(np.allclose(v, [x, y]) for v in vertices) for x, y in zip(curve["Impact Value"], curve["Density"])) print(impact_type, "all table points verified;", "facecolor:", collection.get_facecolor()) continue
